overall: The AG found the Flag Day Parade Committee was created at the direction of the mayor, who retains discretion over the parade, so it falls under the Connelly exception, is not subject to the Open Meeting Law, and did not violate it.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the parade committee held meetings without following Open Meeting Law requirements; committee found not a public body under the Connelly exception.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore conclude that the Committee fits squarely within the Connelly exception and it is therefore not subject to the Open Meeting Law, and did not violate its requirements.
